profile.headline: Computer Whisperer | Fitness Enthusiast
profile.summary:
I am a self taught Full-Stack Developer, but started my career as a Composites Engineer for Boeing Research & Technology. I always enjoy the challenges of learning new technologies and getting new projects off the ground. 

My primary strengths: React Native, Node.js, Typescript, SQL, GraphQL, UX

positions.title: Full-Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
We are a relationship focused consulting group that solves complex problems using software driven solutions.

Products Contributed To:
Pristine Auction Website www.pristineauction.com - PHP MVC Website. Memorabilia Auction website and Warehouse Management System

Website Highlights
- Built UI for customers and Admins to interact with Live Stream auctions using WebRTC (WHIP/WHEP) and Agora Video

Pristine Auction Backend Services - PHP REST API

Backend Highlights 
- Added OpenAPI documentation for all routes with Stoplight Elements for documentation UI

Pristine Auction Android App - React Native with Typescript

Android App (React Native) Highlights
- Converted legacy Javascript project to Typescript
- Built Client-side implementation for live streamed instant auctions using WebRTC (WHIP/WHEP) and Agora Video
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Node.js · PHP · MySQL · Open API · TypeScript · Test-Driven Development · React Native

positions.title: Product Engineer
positions.description:
STRIVE delivers the only data platform proven to optimize muscle performance for elite athletes and teams. Through proprietary algorithms and sensors that seamlessly integrate into any compression clothing, STRIVE provides the most complete, accurate and actionable data for athletes to always compete at peak performance. Founded in 2016, STRIVE currently works with NCAA, NFL, EPL, and MLS teams, along with the US Military. For more information visit http://strive.tech/

Primary Responsibilities
- Champion for UX and Product on the software team
- Assist leadership with product definition to identify and conceptualize new features. 
- Consult on User Research efforts.
- Review designs to provide Engineering and UX feedback. This is an iterative process applied to everything from atomic UI components to multiple screen flows.
- Help review and maintain consistency within Strive's internal design library.
- Develop bluetooth enabled and data intensive React Native apps to provide athletes, coaches, and trainers with realtime biometric data in an easy to digest and actionable format.
- Develop GraphQL API with NestJS and PostrgreSQL to serve Strive's mobile apps and other services
- Consult on SQL database design and constructing complex operations

Tech Stack:
- Typescript
- React Native
- Apollo GraphQL
- NestJS
- PostgreSQL
- NX Monorepo
- GitlabCI
- Detox
- Jest

positions.description:

- React (web), Web Audio API, Howler, Sass, Bootstrap
- Hired to develop an MVP for a beatboxing kids game.

positions.title: Full-Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Pristine Auction - https://www.pristineauction.com/
- PHP, Zend Framework, MYSQL, JS, Jquery, HTML, CSS
- Built and designed end-to-end features from database table creation to the UI.
- Collaborated on advanced warehouse management system to provide visibility into and simplify shipping, receiving, inventory management, and other product processing steps.
- Lots of Unit and Integration testing. Led efforts to increase testing and frameworks to make writing tests faster and the tests more robust.
- Heavy focus on database design and writing efficient MYSQL queries, often in raw SQL. 

Printforia - https://www.printforia.com/
- PHP Mezzio, Vanilla JS, jQuery, Bootstrap, MYSQL
- Design and Develop a Order Management System and Quality Management System for Print on Demand T-shirts
- Led frontend design and UX for both systems.
- Focused on easy to use search interfaces for the OMS
- Focused on streamlining the quality inspection and reporting process by drastically reducing the number of user interactions to record defects and analyze collected data.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
Boeing Research & Technology

Software Development
    - Designed and implemented python program eliminating 100s of hours of repetitive labor processing  csv files. Built GUI and froze the code as .exe to allow for use on all lab computers.
    - Designed and built a web based calculator for drill motor component parts. Used HTML/CSS and Javascript/jQuery UI to create a simple and clear interface for shop use.

Program Management
     -	Managed a team of 8 engineers and technicians developing a robotic extrusion process. Coordinated with multiple teams and the key stakeholders to set proper milestones to ultimately prove technology readiness for production.
     -	Lead Lab Optimization Team to develop and institute lean practices such as using visual controls to reduce overhead associated with consumable material resupply. Also implemented user friendly procedures for clean-as-you-go resulting in better lab space utilization and nearly eliminating lab maintenance overhead.
     -	Managed a team of 6 senior engineers on a $16M full scale manufacturing demonstration which we completed on time despite starting a month later than expected and late additions of new features by the customer.

Manufacturing Design
     -	Designed and developed new technologies that resulted in 6 submissions to the US Patent Office (1 awarded 5 pending) and 7 Boeing invention awards.
     -	Designed processes and equipment spanning multiple technology domains from material handling and manipulation to robotics and additive manufacturing.
     -	Used Solidworks to design dozens of 3D printed parts to be used on production equipment and various research projects.

Manufacturing Research
     -	Designed and performed multiple experiments to characterize the effectiveness of various manufacturing technology and then processed the resultant data to present to prospective internal customers. Authored several internal reports that are still frequently referred to.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
I spent back to back summers working as an intern. 

Charleston
- First ever intern for Boeing Research & Technology in Charleston
- Analyzed data from the first 70 787s manufactured to identify the root cause of reoccurring defects
- Developed method of visualizing data that was so effective that it is still in use 5 years later

Tukwila
- Developed new fabrication methods for composite fuselages.
- Awarded patent for Systems and methods for compacting a charge of composite material (US9314976)

patents.title: Ventilation systems for use with a plasma treatment system
patents.description: A gas containment apparatus for use with an end effector including at least one plasma head includes at least one enclosing structure coupled to the end effector. The enclosing structure is configured to capture a gas produced by the at least one plasma head. The gas containment apparatus also includes a duct coupled to the at least one enclosing structure and configured to channel the gas from within the enclosing structure.

patents.title: Systems, methods, and vacuum chucks for transferring flexible elongate bodies
patents.description: Systems, methods, and vacuum chucks for transferring flexible elongate bodies are disclosed herein. The vacuum chucks include an elongate rigid support, a vertically oriented vacuum surface, a vacuum manifold, and a skirt seal. The systems include an elongate horizontal support structure, a transfer structure, a plurality of vertical linkages, which are operatively attached to the elongate horizontal support structure, and a plurality of vacuum chucks. Each of the plurality of vacuum chucks is operatively attached to a respective one of the plurality of vertical linkages. The methods include suspending an elongate horizontal support structure with a transfer structure, aligning each of a plurality of vacuum chucks with a respective portion of a vertical surface of a flexible elongate body, selectively actuating each of the plurality of vacuum chucks to retain the respective portion of the vertical surface of the flexible elongate body, and lifting the flexible elongate body.
